products.name: FurAway Pro Grooming Vacuum Kit
products.blurb: Brush, de-shed, and trim while the built-in vacuum catches loose fur before it ever reaches your sofa.
products.description: Shedding season, handled. The FurAway Pro connects five grooming tools — de-shedding brush, grooming brush, nozzle, cleaning brush, and clipper head — to a quiet vacuum that pulls loose fur straight into a sealed 1.5L canister as you groom. Low-noise motor (under 60dB) keeps nervous pets calm, and the suction is adjustable for thick double coats or short-haired cats. No more fur tumbleweeds, no more lint-rolling the couch every night. Empties in one click.

Gentle enough for daily use, sturdy enough to live by the front door, and the whole thing pulls apart to rinse clean in seconds. Pick the size that matches your dog's paw.

products.name: Lick'n'Chill Slow Feeder Mat (2-Pack)

Two textures in the pack: one for thick spreads, one that makes soft food last even longer. Dishwasher safe, food-grade silicone.
